question: List concert names with singer IDs.
gold_pre: SELECT c.concert_Name, sc.Singer_ID FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID ORDER BY c.Concert_ID, sc.Singer_ID
gold_post: SELECT concert_Name, Singer_ID FROM concert_performance ORDER BY Concert_ID, Singer_ID

question: Count singers per concert.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Concert_ID, COUNT(*) AS singer_count FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID GROUP BY c.Concert_ID ORDER BY c.Concert_ID
gold_post: SELECT Concert_ID, COUNT(*) AS singer_count FROM concert_performance GROUP BY Concert_ID ORDER BY Concert_ID

question: Concerts in 2015 with singer IDs.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Concert_ID, sc.Singer_ID FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE c.Year=2015 ORDER BY sc.Singer_ID
gold_post: SELECT Concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM concert_performance WHERE Year=2015 ORDER BY Singer_ID

question: Themes with singer counts.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Theme, COUNT(*) FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID GROUP BY c.Theme ORDER BY c.Theme
gold_post: SELECT Theme, COUNT(*) FROM concert_performance GROUP BY Theme ORDER BY Theme

question: Distinct concert names.
gold_pre: SELECT DISTINCT c.concert_Name FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID ORDER BY c.concert_Name
gold_post: SELECT DISTINCT concert_Name FROM concert_performance ORDER BY concert_Name

question: Singer names in concert 2.
gold_pre: SELECT s.Name FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON s.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID WHERE sc.Concert_ID=2 ORDER BY s.Name
gold_post: SELECT s.Name FROM singer s JOIN concert_performance cp ON s.Singer_ID=cp.Singer_ID WHERE cp.Concert_ID=2 ORDER BY s.Name

question: Themes for singer 3.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Theme FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE sc.Singer_ID=3 ORDER BY c.Theme
gold_post: SELECT Theme FROM concert_performance WHERE Singer_ID=3 ORDER BY Theme

question: Count distinct concerts for singer 5.
gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.Concert_ID) FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE sc.Singer_ID=5
gold_post: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Concert_ID) FROM concert_performance WHERE Singer_ID=5

question: List concert names with singer names.
gold_pre: SELECT c.concert_Name, s.Name FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID JOIN singer s ON s.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID ORDER BY c.Concert_ID, s.Name
gold_post: SELECT cp.concert_Name, s.Name FROM concert_performance cp JOIN singer s ON s.Singer_ID=cp.Singer_ID ORDER BY cp.Concert_ID, s.Name

question: Concerts held in stadium 2.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Concert_ID FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID=2 ORDER BY c.Concert_ID
gold_post: SELECT Concert_ID FROM concert_performance WHERE Stadium_ID=2 ORDER BY Concert_ID

question: Singer counts per theme in 2014.
gold_pre: SELECT c.Theme, COUNT(*) FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE c.Year=2014 GROUP BY c.Theme ORDER BY c.Theme
gold_post: SELECT Theme, COUNT(*) FROM concert_performance WHERE Year=2014 GROUP BY Theme ORDER BY Theme

question: Singer IDs for 'Week 1' concerts.
gold_pre: SELECT sc.Singer_ID FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.Concert_ID=sc.Concert_ID WHERE c.concert_Name='Week 1' ORDER BY sc.Singer_ID
gold_post: SELECT Singer_ID FROM concert_performance WHERE concert_Name='Week 1' ORDER BY Singer_ID

question: List stadium locations.
gold_pre: SELECT Location FROM stadium ORDER BY Stadium_ID
gold_post: SELECT Location FROM stadium ORDER BY Stadium_ID

question: List all concert themes.
gold_pre: SELECT Theme FROM concert ORDER BY Concert_ID

question: Count concerts by year.
gold_pre: SELECT Year, COUNT(*) FROM concert GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year
